visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is a split-screen composition featuring a young male creator, Gary, in a picture-in-picture box at the top right. He wears a black beanie, black glasses, and a dark green T-shirt, speaking into a professional-grade microphone against a white interior wall. The primary screen shows a high-definition capture of the mobile game Arena of Valor, displaying a vibrant green forest and river map with a complex HUD overlaying character stats and skill buttons. (2) The visual transitions into a fast-paced gameplay montage where the main character, a sniper hero, aims at enemies using a distinct blue targeting line. Gary's facial expressions change rapidly from deep focus with squinted eyes to joyful laughter as he hits his targets. Brightly colored damage numbers, gold coin icons, and health bars frequently flash across the center of the screen, indicating successful combat actions within the game's interface. (3) The sequence concludes with more technical gameplay maneuvers including quick dashes and area-of-effect abilities. Gary gestures with his hands while talking, and the screen is filled with dynamic visual effects such as purple light bursts and glowing skill circles. Social media handles for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook are consistently displayed in a semi-transparent black bar at the bottom of the frame.

A fast-tempo, major-mode electronic track featuring synthesized bass and percussive beats begins immediately. The mix is clear with the vocals positioned prominently above a low-volume music bed. (2) A sharp, metallic 'ping' SFX from the game triggers a sudden increase in vocal arousal; Gary shouts '狙!' with high intensity and sharp pitch contour. This is followed by a sequence of rapid digital impact sounds and coin-collection chimes that synchronize with his energetic commentary. (3) The phase transitions into more analytical speech where Gary's pace remains fast but his tone is instructional. Multiple UI-based 'bubble' SFX and short 'whoosh' transitions punctuate the audio track every few seconds, reflecting the dense editing style of the gaming highlights montage. By combining high-energy vocal reactions with fast-paced visual editing and descriptive subtitles, it aims to engage the gaming community with successful combat feats and humorous commentary.
